literature_scope.claim: The defensible contribution is a reproducible, dataset-specific sensitivity audit of a PhenoVoxel circuit illustration. The crossed/uncrossed organization, differing steering effects, related premotor pathways, bilateral comparisons and indirect-connectivity methods already have substantial primary-literature precedent.
literature_scope.candidateIncrement: An openly reported complete parameter grid can identify which details of this particular MaleCNS two-edge summary are stable and which depend on analysis choices. Finding a sign reversal or route-rank instability would be an exploratory computational result about the analysis, not a new demonstrated mechanism of steering.
literature_scope.searchLimit: Targeted search of primary papers, official dataset documentation and linked code descriptions. Not an exhaustive systematic review; failure to locate an identical sweep does not prove novelty.
